slides.title: Catch the big words.
slides.body: "You always cancel." "I never get it right." "Nobody listens." Notice when a word like that shows up in your head or out loud.

slides.title: Ask: is it true?
slides.body: Every time? Not once the other way? Usually you can think of an exception. That's the story stretching past the facts.

slides.title: Say the honest version.
slides.body: "You've cancelled twice this month, and it hurt." Smaller, truer, and much easier for someone to hear.

slides.title: Try it this week.
slides.body: Count your always and never. Pick one and rewrite it as what actually happened. What does the big word protect you from saying?
